# invites.blog

> One link for a whole celebration: an animated invitation, the replies, and every photo the guests
> take. Hosts build personalised, role-aware invitations from a template gallery (or upload their
> own); guests open their link, reply, and add photos from the camera in the invitation or a QR code
> on the table, with no app.

- Public site (this page, plans, guides, policies): https://invites.blog
- The web app (sign in, create and manage events, the template designer, billing): https://app.invites.blog
- Guests' invitation and album links stay on invites.blog and me.invites.blog.

## What you can do

- **Template designer** (free for every account, in the browser, also on a phone): design your own
  animated invitation. Text (split into words or letters), photos, shapes, a pen and brushes, free
  public-domain art, moving stickers; a timeline with keyframes and one-tap effects (fade, fly, zoom,
  turn, reveal, wipe, flip, draw, loops like float and pulse) tied to scroll; fields that fill in each
  guest's name, the date, venue, gallery, a reply button and a camera. Publish it Private, For one
  person (by email), or Public in the Templates gallery. The AI designer (Ask AI) builds or changes a design
  from a message; it is an add-on to Premium and comes with Studio. Guide: [Template designer](/guide/template-designer).
- **Animated invitations**: pick a design from the Templates gallery; each guest sees their own name
  and the details for their role. Or upload your own picture or video.
- **Save the date**: send the date first with an Add to calendar link, then turn it into the invitation.
- **Sending**: invites.blog emails each guest their own link. WhatsApp, Viber and Telegram are sent
  from your own phone with one tap per guest (no automatic sending on those). Phone numbers from any country.
- **Replies and guest lists**: upload an Excel guest list or add people one by one; roles, one-tap RSVP,
  or an open guest list where visitors reply with a name.
- **Time zones**: every event has one. Dates and times are shown in the event's zone, in the viewer's own
  date order and clock style, with "(your time)" beside them when the viewer's clock differs.
- **Photo albums**: guests add photos and videos with the camera in the invitation or a QR code, no app.
  Press and hold to select, then Share or Download (up to 10 at a time; more, and Download all as one zip
  of any size, with Premium, Photographer, Studio or in an event with a Gold or Platinum pass); Save to your phone's gallery;
  filter by person or by photos and videos; grouping of photos by face with any pass, Premium, Photographer or Studio, off unless the host turns it on; double-tap to heart a photo, with counts and a
  Favourites page; owners are notified of hearts.
- **Event page**: each event becomes a post with its photos, likes and comments, visible to invited people.
- **Portfolios** (with Photographer or Studio): a public page at invites.blog/@yourname to show your work, with
  collections (grid, mosaic or slideshow), an about section, packages, reviews, your invitation designs and contact
  buttons with an enquiry form. Each collection is either past work uploaded straight from your phone or computer
  (JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC, up to 30 MB each; stored as web copies with location and camera details removed), or
  photos picked from your own uploads in your events, once you confirm for each event that the people it is for
  agreed. Up to 500 photos in all; visitors can ask for a photo to be removed. Set it up at app.invites.blog/portfolio
  or in the app.
- **View invite**: the host can open the invitation exactly as guests see it, read-only, from the event's tile.
- **Photo window**: guests add photos during the event's photo days; after they end, new QR codes and links for
  adding photos can't be made, and everyone can still look at the albums.
- **Getting started**: an [example event](/example-event) to look around before starting one, a Getting started
  checklist, and short one-time tips and tours for new accounts (Settings › Tips turns them off or shows them again).
- **Apps**: iPhone ([App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/invites-blog/id6829749209)); an Android app is on the way. In-app purchases go through the stores and are
  priced in US dollars; website purchases are by card through Bank of Maldives.

## Pricing

- [Pricing](/pricing): free to make, share and collect replies, with 300 MB of photos and one album for
  every event (guests add photos from the day before to the day after; kept forever).
  - Gold pass, MVR 199 (about $13) once per event: 5 GB, 2 albums, photos until 3 days after,
    100 invitations emailed for you, kept a year.
  - Platinum pass, MVR 499 (about $32) once per event: 10 GB, 5 albums, photos until 5 days after,
    private albums, 500 invitations emailed for you, kept a year.
  - Another year of a pass: Gold MVR 99, Platinum MVR 349. "Keep your photos": MVR 150 a year. More
    emailed invitations: MVR 50 per 100. Sharing your own link is always free.
  - Premium: MVR 77 (about $5; $4.99 in the iPhone app) a month; every event you organise gets 2 GB, no mark, face grouping,
    photos kept while you subscribe; Download all and more than 10 at once in any album you can see.
    The AI designer (the template designer's Ask AI assistant) is an add-on: MVR 77 more a month
    (Premium with it: MVR 154; $9.99 in the iPhone app). Studio (for businesses that run events: resorts, halls, planners):
    MVR 775 ($49.99 in the iPhone app) a month; every event you organise gets 10 GB, no mark and face grouping, photos kept while
    you're on Studio, Download all, the AI designer included, and your profile picture and name on its
    albums, QR cards and posts, plus your own portfolio page at invites.blog/@yourname. Photographer
    (for photographers): MVR 540 (about $35; $34.99 in the iPhone app) a month: your own portfolio page at
    invites.blog/@yourname, 10 GB on every event you organise, face grouping, no "Made with" mark, photos
    kept while you're on Photographer, Download all, and your picture and name on its albums, QR cards and posts.
  - When a pass, Premium, Photographer or Studio ends, the event goes back to Free: up to 300 MB is kept
    for good, after warnings 30, 7 and 1 days before anything above that is removed. A portfolio is
    unavailable at once when its plan ends and is deleted 90 days later.
